description: Change a .tscn safely without the editor, touching only the lines of that change. `op` and its fields: add_node (parent, name, and type or instance), remove_node (node; with its children, connections and the resources only it used), set (node, property, value; checked against Godot 4.7, enums by name, resources as res:// files), connect and disconnect (from, signal, to, method; checks the signal exists, warns when the method is missing or takes the wrong number of arguments, with the func line to add), attach_script (node, script; refuses a script that extends another node type), set_editable (node, editable). A change inside an instance that is not editable is refused, because Godot drops it on the next editor save; make_editable adds [editable] with it. Node paths are relative to the scene root ".". Without `write` it returns the diff and warnings; with `write: true` it writes and reports the review errors before and after (an error result when there are more after). A missing field or a refused change is an error and writes nothing. For project.godot use godot_project_edit; to rename a node everywhere, godot_rename.

editable.description: set_editable: false to make it not editable (default true)

from.description: connect/disconnect: path of the node that emits

instance.description: add_node: a res:// scene to instance instead of a type

make_editable.description: add_node/set/connect: also make the instance editable when the change is inside one

name.description: add_node: name of the new node

node.description: remove_node/set/attach_script/set_editable: path of the node ("." is the root)

parent.description: add_node: path of the parent ("." is the root)

scene.description: the scene: res://main.tscn, or a path

script.description: attach_script: res:// path of the script

to.description: connect/disconnect: path of the node that receives

type.description: add_node: a Godot node class, e.g. Sprite2D

value.description: set: the value, e.g. Vector2(10, 20), 3, true, ALWAYS, res://icon.svg, null

write.description: write the change (default false: show the diff only)

name: godot_scene_edit
title: Change a scene
